hotspots.title: Main stage & screen
hotspots.description: User-confirmed concept footprint: stage 50 × 12 ft (15.24 × 3.6576 m), main LED face 75 × 20 ft (22.86 × 6.096 m). This does not approve height, mounting, structural loads or room fit. The proposed stage overlaps two equipment-well references that require review.

hotspots.title: Four-table coding pods
hotspots.description: All 192 original Hall B table centers, row/group IDs and four-table group breaks are preserved. The 6 × 3 ft table footprint is sourced. Two original schematic chair marks per table remain at their source bounds; 3D chair dimensions and table heights are illustrative. No three extra occupied chairs have been invented.

hotspots.title: Production & crew
hotspots.description: Height-adjustable operations desks, audio controls, a camera position and black production screening. Furniture silhouettes and all positions are illustrative; no whole-event inventory totals are assigned to this zone.

hotspots.title: Registration & arrival
hotspots.description: A conceptual arrival point with self-service registration kiosks, an acrylic counter, blue-and-white wayfinding, plants and water refill. This is a proposed function inside the exhibition proof, not a verified venue room allocation.

hotspots.title: Venue architecture reference
hotspots.description: Column and equipment-well footprints follow the supplied venue geometry. Cream walls, ceiling grid and blue glazing reference historic photographs. Wall/ceiling elevations and clear wall faces are unverified. Photographic Hall A/B identity remains unverified.

hotspots.title: Cable crossing
hotspots.description: A visible protected crossing illustrates the cable-management requirement. Its position does not establish approved electrical routing, circulation or emergency egress.

hotspots.title: Original layout review flags
hotspots.description: The supplied geometry flags 32 chair-boundary positions, 14 equipment-well positions and two wells under the proposed stage across the full layout. These source flags are preserved; no table or chair mark was moved to hide them. Occupied-chair fit, clearances, well access and egress remain to be reviewed.

hotspots.title: Hall A source positions
hotspots.description: 256 original tables and 512 original schematic chair marks, with their row and four-table group identities. Column/well footprints and source review flags are retained. Physical chair dimensions, all heights and as-built clearances remain unverified.
